Democrats have long dreamed of flipping a major statewide seat blue in Texas. And Democratic state representative James Talarico is consistently polling ahead of his rival, Republican state attorney Ken Paxton, in the race for U.S. Senate. 

https://www.vox.com/politics/507005/texas-senate-race-talarico-paxton-masculinity

So why might this year be the year Democrats finally realize their dreams? And what does being a “real man” have to do with it? Find out on Today, Explained, wherever you get your podcasts.
